visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene is an 2D animation with a flat white background. A tall man in blue ancient-style clothing and a small child in brown clothing are sitting on a grey horse/donkey walking to the right. Text appears at the top. (2) A man in a green shirt and yellow headband enters from the right, smiling and gesturing towards the riders. The tall man in blue looks back with a neutral expression. (3) The tall man in blue is now walking on foot behind the horse while the child in brown sits on the animal. The passerby continues to talk and point. (4) The child in brown is now walking while the tall man in blue sits on the animal. The passerby's expression turns judgmental. (5) Both the tall man and the child are walking on the left side of the horse. The passerby is laughing at them. (6) The camera cuts to a close-up of the horse's face, which is drawn with exaggerated anger, red veins in the eyes, and gritted teeth. It raises a hoof and hits the passerby in the head, causing his eyes to bulge.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To subvert a well-known moral fable (The Man, the Boy, and the Donkey) for comedic effect. While the original story highlights the impossibility of pleasing everyone, this version ends with the 'donkey' aggressively asserting it is actually a horse, venting its frustration on the critical bystander.
